DEFAULT VALUES has no source-expression indices and must skip ordinary-source evaluation.

Known feature gaps/survey remained; two additional harness failures came from a single-statement Lean helper being given setup batches and a crash workload using an unsupported writable CTE. Split setup statements and direct multi-VALUES replace those harness assumptions; the independent native end-to-end SQL control agrees before any expected value is changed.
All maintained BEFORE INSERT regressions pass in both public file modes.

implementation: Matching multi-VALUES inputs are materialized before programs. A single VALUES source keeps selected ordinary expressions in physical-column order, with discarded duplicate targets prepared but not evaluated. Defaults and affinity-adjusted/generated values form the actual typed provisional NEW image before constraints. An unspecified rowid is -1 in NEW and remains NULL for actual allocation.

The separate IPK expression executes before and after BEFORE programs. Reached scalar/EXISTS registers retain actual values, comparison affinity and subtypes; surrounding connection counters remain executable. CASE bases are duplicated by pinned SQLite code generation, and IN sources retain their separate reads. Conditional/coalesce/IN-list paths avoid evaluation of unreached scalar subqueries.

The post-program read handles still-unreached subqueries in the current state; the existing point machinery then allocates from the real current table and applies constraints. BEFORE body insertions/deletions can change automatic rowid allocation. RETURNING and AFTER retain the actual accepted image and subtypes.

Captured trigger-body INSERT preparation now uses generated-column target admission. Rowid UNIQUE errors identify the actual table/PK column in schema-default policy paths. No native SQL or oracle result enters execution.
reference_protocol: Complete stdout/exit/first-error and independently observed persisted catalog/table/integrity contents compare with pinned SQLite 3.53.4. Twelve generated BEFORE inputs use a new final-checkpoint seed; all earlier suites are rerun with fresh generated inputs. Native same-process register probes are exploratory evidence, explicitly separate from the fresh-connection final comparisons. No skips or expected-output rewrites are used.
crash_scope: SIGKILL timing samples for BEFORE INSERT writes to two tables, provisional NEW=-1 body values and actual rowid allocation for materialized multi-VALUES input into a uniquely indexed target. Public Lean recovery followed by independent SQLite catalog/root-zero/rowid/schema-cookie/row/integrity checks. Complete old or new states are required. No every-syscall, power-loss or arbitrary-schedule claim.
primary_source_basis: Pinned insert.c ordinary register order, provisional IPK copy, pre-program affinity/type checks, separate actual IPK evaluation and source materialization; expr.c scalar subroutine reuse, CASE-base duplication and lazy control flow. Independent native controls determine outcomes.
proof_scope: Retained Core/file/physical and signed-counter contracts compile. Audited component laws cover query-free cache preservation and unchanged UPDATE commands through INSERT finalization. A new executable group checks generated/rowid images, nested AFTER ordering, caller registers and mixed cached-subquery/live-counter expressions. No complete VDBE equivalence theorem is claimed.
limitations: Separate 14-case nested captured INSERT diagnostics still have 12 failures (scalar subtype loss, discarded expression evaluation, mixed key counters and multi-VALUES materialization); these are recorded separately and are the next fix. Volatile/default/affinity/query combinations, INSTEAD OF/temp triggers, RAISE, recursive_triggers settings, triggered UPSERT and trigger-aware ALTER remain work. These suites do not exhaust BEFORE INSERT semantics.
Eight of 88 named probes still fail: WITHOUT ROWID, composite primary keys and partial/expression indexes, both modes. These probes do not define global coverage.

UTF-16 writes/setters, native-key/materialization limits, pending new physical allocations and earlier SQL/storage limitations remain. The finite process-kill samples do not establish every syscall/power-loss schedule.
